violation_type.title: Sanitize Table Tops, Furniture, Equipment (26 TAC §744.2507(9))
violation_type.typical_finding: Toys are only being cleaned with soap and water; they are not being sanitized. This was corrected at inspection.

finding_variants.text: Toys are only being cleaned with soap and water; they are not being sanitized. This was corrected at inspection.
Tables were sanitized with a Clorox wipe only before children were served snack.
It was observed that neither of the tables being used by the different groups were sanitized after dinner as they transitioned into homework.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.

Prior to eating snack, surfaces children were eating on top of had not been cleaned or sanitized.  Children had been sitting on top of a bench in the room prior to being served snack and then placed their snack directly on top of the bench area while eating.    There was not a cleaning or sanitizing solution available.
The operation utilizes Clorox wipes only to clean and sanitize table tops.  A spray bottle sanitizing system has not been provided for the caregivers to use.    NOTE:  This is a re-cite.
The table tops were not sanitized prior to eating their meal and the children were using the same tables for playing games and using school equipment.
